name: two_armed_bandit
label: Two-Armed Bandit
description: Every trial, both arms run the dispense motion but only one delivers a pellet (chosen by reward probability, flipping every N trials in blocks) — the animal can't use sound or vibration alone to find the baited arm.

parameters.label: Arms (exactly 2)
parameters.help: Select exactly two nodes — the two arms of the task

parameters.label: Trials per block
parameters.help: The rich/lean arm flips after this many trials

parameters.label: Rich-arm probability
parameters.help: Chance the rich arm delivers on a given trial (lean arm delivers at 1 - this)

parameters.label: Empty-arm dwell (s)
parameters.help: How long the empty arm holds at the drop position before raising

parameters.label: Inter-trial quiet (s)
parameters.help: Required seconds of inactivity (both domes closed) before the next trial

parameters.label: Inter-trial max wait (s)
parameters.help: Start the next trial anyway after this long, even if not quiet

parameters.label: Trial timeout (s)
parameters.help: Abandon a trial (and log it) if the pellet isn't taken within this long
